requirement: Хранить ExtractionResult: input ref, format, extractor/code/dependency/options versions, canonical block manifest SHA, warnings/losses/physical coverage и состояние сохранности. Текст и блоки сохраняются по составу/retention DA2. Новая версия экстрактора создаёт новую запись без перезаписи прежней; доступность её содержимого определяется профилем хранения.
assessment: The J132 historical/direct/zero-selection persistence caveat is stale after J147, J150/J154 and J161. No concrete current mutating-consumer bypass of a completed production ExtractionResult was found. Full fact-to-block coordinates remain DA3.2, not an additional DA3.4 storage requirement.

requirements.actual: ExtractionResult.artifact_sha256 references known complete-body metadata. Components identify five actual roles through qualified-name/source-file hashes; dependencies record Python/pypdf/olefile/inflate64 versions, unavailable values explicit. Options and package-policy version/source SHA bind the extraction. Per-part formats/views distinguish PDF/Word/ODT/DOC/Word XML/unknown.

Canonical physical manifest covers all physical part summaries. Retained selected summaries include block/page manifest SHA, counts, error/limitation/loss summaries; Word includes body+notes manifest identity. Rejected material has count/hash. Max16 selected summaries/16KiB, omitted-selected count explicit; this is bounded metadata, not a full execution trace or verbatim warning log.

Explicit bodies=not_retained, physical_coordinates=manifest_not_retained, input_mapping=unmapped, completeness=not_asserted. DOC/standalone XML have actual route/unlocated manifest and unknown coordinates/fields/notes, not a missing result. DA2 excludes permanent raw/block archives; mandatory pending payload protection remains separate.

Production TextLoader uses ProvenanceTextExtractor; its known URL-free results survive independently of admitted source graphs. Pipeline and mutating CLI finalizers save complete-body parents then every known result in the caller transaction with Clock. Generic prefilter/primary/review/secondary/history and RCL/Senate observations also attach actual results; blocked/unsafe source graphs do not suppress independent extraction persistence.

Result ID hashes the versioned metadata including code/dependencies/options/manifests. Repository requires existing exact body metadata, INSERT ON CONFLICT preserves prior rows/first recording time, and typed read checks result/body IDs. New versions append; no legacy paid-input provenance is inferred.
